summary: Every legal positive 32-bit input has at most ten decimal digits, which is too small a domain for a stable runtime-scaling verdict between digit-counting strategies.

workload_bound.source_constraint: n is from 1 through 2^31 - 1, so its decimal representation has at most 10 digits

replacement_checks.evidence: The accepted implementation performs one Counter update for each of at most ten decimal characters, then compares at most ten present-digit entries using the exact frequency and digit tie-break key.
Authored cases cover one digit, all equal digits, all unique digits, digit zero, tied minima, frequency priority over digit value, a ten-digit power-of-ten form, and the maximum signed 32-bit input.
